text: Looking for a Zoho consultant in Sydney or Auckland? The postcode matters less than you think.
Zoho work happens in your own account, online. Local or remote, it's the same screens.
Go local for on-site workshops, accounting-led projects, or a contract under local law.
Go remote for defined builds. Creator apps, Deluge scripts, integrations.
Either way, create the Zoho account yourself. Check it signs in at zoho.com.au.
Ask where everyone who logs in is based. In Australia, overseas access is usually a disclosure under APP 8.
Get their hours in your time zone, summer and winter. And check GST with your accountant.
Read all six checks at zudoworks.com
